about.metaDesc: The story of Siddesh Mokashi — rangoli artist, portrait artist and teacher from Maharashtra.
about.title: Hello, I'm Siddesh Mokashi
about.sub: I draw people, paint moods and fill doorsteps with colour. This is how it all began.
about.photoAlt: Siddesh Mokashi at work in the studio

story.p: As a child I watched my mother draw rangoli at our door every morning. One day she handed me the powder and said, “Your turn.” I have not stopped since.
From rangoli I moved to pencil and charcoal, then to paint. I learned slowly — from teachers, books and thousands of practice sheets — and I still learn something new with every piece.

story.h: Why rangoli still matters to me
story.p: A rangoli lasts a day or two, and that is its beauty. It says “welcome” to everyone who comes to the door. I want my art to feel the same: warm, open and made for your home.

helpPage.metaTitle: Help — how to order, pay and get delivery
helpPage.metaDesc: Simple answers for buying art online: how to order, pay with UPI or cash on delivery, delivery times, returns, portraits, event bookings and courses.
helpPage.title: Buying online, made simple
helpPage.sub: Tap a question to see the answer. Still stuck? Message me on WhatsApp — I am happy to help.

items.a: Open a piece you like and tap “Add to cart”. Then open your cart and tap “Go to payment”. Fill in your name, mobile number and address, choose how to pay, and you are done. You will get a confirmation on WhatsApp.

items.q: Do I need to create an account?
items.a: No. Your mobile number is enough. You can follow your order from the link on the order page.

items.q: Can I order on WhatsApp instead?
items.a: Yes. Tap “Order on WhatsApp” on any piece, or send me a photo of what you like. I will confirm the price and delivery with you.
UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm and others), debit or credit card, net banking or wallets. Payments are handled safely by Razorpay — I never see your card or UPI PIN.

items.q: Can I pay cash on delivery?
items.a: Yes, for prints and originals on orders up to {codMax}. A cash-on-delivery fee of {codFee} is added. I confirm every cash-on-delivery order with you on WhatsApp before packing it.

items.q: Money was taken but I did not get a confirmation. What now?
items.a: Don't worry — this sometimes takes a few minutes. If you still have no confirmation after 30 minutes, message me on WhatsApp. If the order did not go through, the bank returns the money automatically within 5–7 working days.
Most orders reach you in 5–8 days anywhere in India. Framed pieces take about 3 days more. You will get the tracking link on WhatsApp.
{shipFee} for orders under {freeFrom}. Free for orders of {freeFrom} and above. Digital downloads have no delivery charge.

Prints can be returned within 7 days. Originals can be returned within 3 days only if they were damaged on the way. Digital downloads and approved custom work can't be returned. Refunds reach you in 5–7 working days.

items.q: How does a custom portrait work?
items.a: Fill in the short portrait form, then send your photos on WhatsApp. You pay an advance by a secure link, I send you a preview photo to approve, and then I ship it. It usually takes 10–14 days.

items.q: How do I book rangoli for an event?
items.a: Send your date and place through the event form or on WhatsApp. Together we choose the design and colours, you pay an advance to keep the date, and on the day I draw it at your venue.

items.q: How do the online courses work?
items.a: Courses are short video lessons you can watch on your phone, any time. Lessons are in Marathi or Hindi, or have subtitles. Online courses are opening soon — message me to hear first.
WhatsApp is the quickest — I reply within a few hours, 9 am to 8 pm. You can also call or email; all the details are on the Contact page.

shipping.title: Shipping policy
shipping.metaDesc: Delivery charges, times and cash on delivery for orders from Siddesh Mokashi.
shipping.summary: Delivery across India in 5–8 days. {shipFee} delivery on orders under {freeFrom}; free from {freeFrom}.

p: I ship to every pincode in India that my courier partners reach. I don't ship outside India yet — if you live abroad, message me on WhatsApp.

list: Orders of {freeFrom} and above: free delivery.
Digital downloads: no delivery charge — you get them by link.

p: Every order is packed by hand. Most orders reach you in 5–8 days; framed pieces take about 3 days more. Dates for portraits and event rangoli are agreed with you on WhatsApp.
Originals are packed flat between boards, protected from water and insured on the way. When your parcel ships, you get the tracking link on WhatsApp, and by email if you gave one.

Cash on delivery is available for prints and originals on orders up to {codMax} (fee included). A cash-on-delivery fee of {codFee} is added. I confirm every cash-on-delivery order with you on WhatsApp before packing it. It is not available for digital downloads or courses.

If your parcel is late, message me on WhatsApp with your order number and I will check with the courier. If it arrives damaged, please take photos or a short video while opening it and send them to me within 3 days — see the Returns policy.

returns.title: Returns & refunds
returns.metaDesc: Returns for prints and originals, refunds and custom work at Siddesh Mokashi.
returns.summary: Prints: return within 7 days. Originals: only if damaged on the way, within 3 days. Digital files and approved custom work can't be refunded. Refunds reach you in 5–7 working days.

p: You can return a print within 7 days of delivery, as long as it is unused and in its original packing. Message me on WhatsApp with your order number and I will tell you how to send it back.
If the print arrived damaged or wrong, I pay for the return. Otherwise, the return shipping is yours.

Each original is one of a kind, so it can be returned only if it was damaged on the way. Tell me within 3 days of delivery and send photos or a short video of the parcel and the piece. I will arrange a pickup and refund you in full, including delivery.
A file can't be given back once it is downloaded, so digital downloads are not refundable. If a file does not open or is the wrong one, message me and I will fix it or send it again.

Custom work is made only for you. If you cancel before I start, your advance is refunded. Before you approve the preview photo, I make changes until you are happy. Once you approve it, the work can't be cancelled or refunded.
Cancellation terms for event rangoli are written in your booking confirmation on WhatsApp. Courses can't be refunded once you have started watching the lessons.

list: Refunds go back to the way you paid — UPI, card, net banking or wallet — within 5–7 working days after I receive the return or confirm the damage.
For cash-on-delivery orders, I send the refund to your bank account or UPI ID; I will ask for it on WhatsApp.
Delivery charges and the cash-on-delivery fee are refunded only when the item arrived damaged or wrong.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.metaDesc: What personal data this website collects, why, how long it is kept and how to see, correct or delete it.
privacy.summary: I collect only what I need to deliver your order and reply to you. I never sell your data. You can ask to see, correct or delete it any time.

p: This website is run by {legalName} ({brand}), {address}. Under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, I am responsible (the “data fiduciary”) for the personal data you share here.

list: Your name, mobile number and email.
What you order and how you paid. Payments are handled by Razorpay — I never see or keep your card details or UPI PIN.
Messages and enquiries you send me.
Your GSTIN and business name, if you ask for a GST invoice.
To deliver your order and send you updates on WhatsApp, SMS or email.
To reply to your questions and enquiries.
To make invoices and keep the tax records the law requires.
To send festival offers — only if you ticked the box. You can stop them any time.

p: Only the people who help complete your order: the payment company (Razorpay), the courier, and the services that run this website and send messages. Each gets only what it needs. I never sell your data.

Order and invoice records are kept for as long as tax law requires (currently up to 8 years). Enquiries are deleted 2 years after our last conversation. Permission for offers ends the moment you withdraw it.
Invoices keep the buyer’s name and address for the period the law requires, even if you delete your account.

You can ask to see the data I hold about you, correct it, or delete it (except records the law makes me keep). You can withdraw your permission for messages at any time, and you can name someone to act for you. You can also do it yourself: in My account, under Profile, tap “Download my data” for a copy as a file, or “Delete my account” to have it erased. I will reply to any other request quickly, and always within 30 days. Message me on WhatsApp or write to {email}.

The site keeps a few small things on your own device so it works: your language choice (a cookie), your cart and saved pieces, your animation setting, and your sign-in. These are essential and need no permission.

Some pages can also use optional cookies: analytics (to see which pages people enjoy) and marketing (the Meta pixel, to see which posts and ads bring people here). They are off until you tap Accept or choose them under Choose, and Reject keeps them off. Your choice is stored in a cookie on your device and recorded with the wording you saw. You can change it any time with “Cookie settings” in the footer.
Optional cookies are never used on pages for learners under 18 (see Children), whatever you choose.

Everyone under 18 counts as a child under the law. A learner under 18 does not get an account of their own: a parent or guardian signs in, buys the course, ticks that they agree, and may add the child’s first name (only to print on the certificate).

On pages for under-18 learners (kids and teen courses, their sample lessons, the lesson player, and the account of a parent who has such a course) I load no analytics or advertising pixels and show no cookie or newsletter box, and no offers or marketing messages are sent.

sections.h: See, download or delete your data yourself
p: In My account, under Profile, “Download my data” gives you a file with your profile, orders, courses, progress, certificates, reviews and your cookie and newsletter choices. “Delete my account” removes your name, phone number, saved pieces and any child’s name, and takes your phone number and street address off old orders; invoices stay as tax law requires. Each request is noted in a log with the date it must be answered by (within 30 days). This page is a draft and is to be reviewed by a lawyer.

For any complaint about your personal data, write to the grievance officer: {grievanceName}, {grievanceEmail}. You will get a reply within 48 hours. If you are still not satisfied, you can complain to the Data Protection Board of India.

terms.title: Terms & conditions
terms.metaDesc: The terms for buying art, prints, portraits, event rangoli and courses from Siddesh Mokashi.
terms.summary: Prices are in rupees and include GST. Every piece is hand-made, so small differences from the photo are natural. Artworks and designs stay the artist's copyright.

p: These terms apply when you use this website or buy from {brand}, run by {legalName}, {address}. GSTIN: {gstin}.

All prices are in Indian rupees (₹) and include GST. Delivery and any cash-on-delivery fee are shown before you pay. Payments are handled securely by Razorpay. An order is confirmed only after the payment is verified or, for cash on delivery, after you confirm it on WhatsApp.
Colours on a screen can look slightly different from the real piece, and hand-made work has small variations. These are part of its character, not defects.
Each original exists only once. If two people pay for the same original at the same moment, the second payment is refunded in full automatically.
Price, date and details for portraits and event rangoli are agreed on WhatsApp before you pay an advance. See the Returns policy for cancellations.

All artworks, photos and designs on this site belong to the artist. Buying a piece or print does not give the right to copy, print or sell it. Digital downloads are for your personal use only. Course videos must not be shared or recorded.
The Shipping, Returns and Privacy policies are part of these terms.

If something goes wrong, please message me first — most problems are solved in one conversation. If not, write to the grievance officer: {grievanceName}, {grievanceEmail}. These terms follow Indian law, and courts in {city}, Maharashtra have jurisdiction.

newsletter.title: Festival designs in your inbox
newsletter.body: One email a month: new rangoli designs and festival offers. You can stop any time.
newsletter.consent: Yes, send me the newsletter by email. I can unsubscribe at any time.

errors.consent: Tick the box if you want the newsletter.
errors.rate: Too many tries. Please try again in a little while.
errors.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again.

newsletter.thanks: We have sent you an email. Open it and tap the link to confirm. If you cannot find it, look in your spam folder.
newsletter.confirmBody: Tap the button to start getting the newsletter.
newsletter.confirmedBody: Thank you! You will hear from me before the next festival.
newsletter.invalidTitle: This link has expired or is not valid
newsletter.invalidBody: Please sign up again from the bottom of any page and we will send you a new link.
newsletter.unsubBody: We will not send you the newsletter any more.
newsletter.profileBody: To leave the newsletter, type the email address you signed up with. We will send that address a link to leave.
newsletter.profileDone: If this address is on the list, I've sent it a link to leave.

email.subject: Please confirm your email
email.body: Someone, hopefully you, asked for the newsletter with this email address. To start getting it, open this link within {hours} hours:
email.ignore: If it was not you, just ignore this email. Nothing will be sent to you.
email.leaveBody: Someone asked to stop the newsletter for this email address. To stop it, open this link:

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.nameHint: Only your first name and the first letter of your last name are shown.
reviews.textHint: A few sentences, 10 to 1000 characters. Plain text only.
reviews.photoHint: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 4 MB.

errors.photo: The photo must be a JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 4 MB.
errors.name: Please write your name.
errors.rate: Too many reviews in a short time. Please try again later.

reviews.thanksBody: I read every review before it goes on the website, so yours will show up soon.

reasons.already: You have already reviewed this. Thank you!
reasons.not_buyer: You can review this after your order has been delivered.
reasons.not_enrolled: Only students of this course can review it.
reasons.too_early: Reviews open when you have finished 30% of the lessons. Keep going!

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: Some cookies help me see which pages people enjoy. They are optional and stay off unless you say yes.
cookies.panelBody: The site works without these. Pick what you are happy with, and change your mind any time from the footer.
cookies.analyticsNote: Counts visits and pages (Google Analytics) so I can see what people enjoy.
cookies.marketingNote: Lets Meta measure which of my posts and ads bring people here (Meta pixel).

accountPrivacy.title: Your data
accountPrivacy.body: Download everything this website holds about you as one file: your profile, orders, courses, progress, certificates, reviews and the choices you made about cookies and the newsletter.
